title: West Goshen supervisors take up data center rules Nov. 5
summary: Supervisors meet Thursday, Nov. 5, at 6 p.m. to settle changes to the township's first full zoning rewrite since 1972, including data center rules, a revised Mixed-Use Corridor District and zoning map updates.
loc: West Goshen Township Building, 1025 Paoli Pike, West Chester

title: Victorian carolers will stroll downtown on holiday weekends
summary: Downtown West Chester's costumed Borough Balladeer Carolers return for eight free Friday and Saturday performances from Nov. 27 through Dec. 19, roaming the shopping district rather than singing at one spot.

title: Christmas on King returns to Malvern Nov. 28
summary: The Malvern Business & Professional Association's free festival fills King Street with music, food trucks and visits from Santa from noon to 4 p.m., then moves to Burke Park for performances and the tree lighting.
loc: King Street and Burke Park, Malvern

title: West Chester Railroad's Santa's Express runs Nov. 21 to Dec. 20
summary: The holiday train makes a 75-minute round trip from Market Street Station to Glen Mills on select dates, with Santa visiting each car and a Table Car option with live music. Rides often sell out, so advance booking is advised.

title: Turnpike's widened stretch near Downingtown opens with six lanes
summary: The Pennsylvania Turnpike now carries three lanes each way between mileposts 312 and 316 around the Downingtown Interchange, finishing a $214 million rebuild that began in May 2023. The work also replaced three bridges and added wider shoulders and noise walls.

title: Great Valley football finishes its first unbeaten regular season
summary: A 45-35 home win over West Chester East capped a 10-0 regular season for the Patriots and gave them their first Ches-Mont South title since 1974, a year after going 3-7.

title: Iron Hill's new owner revives five brewpubs, but West Chester stays dark
summary: Downingtown restaurateur Teja Chekuri bought the bankrupt chain's brand and five leases and has reopened all five, in Philadelphia, Wilmington, Huntingdon Valley, Hershey and Lancaster. The former West Chester and Exton locations remain closed, and he says expansion back into Chester County is not on a fast track.

title: Downingtown council to hear e-bike sidewalk ban and fire code update Nov. 4
summary: One proposed ordinance would bar electric-assist bikes from borough sidewalks and let officials limit wheeled devices in parks and playgrounds; a second would adopt the 2021 International Fire Code and revise Knox-box rules. Residents can comment at the 7 p.m. hearing at Borough Hall before council votes.
loc: Borough Hall, 4 W. Lancaster Ave., Downingtown

title: Parents push back on West Chester Area's new middle and high school schedules
summary: District leaders told a board committee on Oct. 19 that the reworked secondary schedules are moving ahead, prompting a parent petition and a Facebook group. Families worry most about lost classroom time, which they estimate at nearly 20 percent in middle school.

title: CVIM offers free dental care to uninsured veterans Nov. 10
summary: Community Volunteers in Medicine is holding its annual Give Veterans a Smile Day at its West Chester health center on Lawrence Drive for area veterans without dental insurance. Appointments are required and fill quickly; call 610-836-5990 ext. 125.
